item.title: This ESO image shows a rare case of a triple merger of galax…
item.author: Mario Livio (@mariolivio.bsky.social)
item.description: This ESO image shows a rare case of a triple merger of galaxies. This system, which astronomers have dubbed 'The Bird' - although it also bears resemblance with a cosmic Tinker Bell - is composed of two massive spiral galaxies and a third irregular galaxy.
